mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with increased consumer spending within 2 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with GDP growth within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with negative GDP growth within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, it indicates a potential mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the described condition does not lead to a policy adjustment within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the described labor market conditions do not correlate with GDP growth within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with GDP growth within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if the decline is accompanied by a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE).
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with negative GDP growth within 6 months.
